US-REG-001.title: User registration
US-REG-001.description: As a new user, I want to create an account.

acceptance_criteria.text: Valid registration opens the workspace.
Name is required and must contain at least 2 characters.
Email is required and must have a valid format.
Duplicate email cannot be registered.
Password must have at least 6 characters, one number and one special character.
Password confirmation must match.
Terms must be accepted.

US-LOGIN-001.title: User login
US-LOGIN-001.description: As a registered user, I want to sign in.

acceptance_criteria.text: Correct credentials open the workspace.
Email and password are required.
Incorrect credentials display an error.

US-TASK-001.title: Create task
US-TASK-001.description: As a user, I want to create a task.

acceptance_criteria.text: Task can be created with a non-empty title.
Empty title displays 'Task title is required.'.
Task may include description, priority, status, category, due date, important flag and subtasks.
Created task appears in the task list.

US-TASK-002.title: Edit task
US-TASK-002.description: As a user, I want to edit a task.

acceptance_criteria.text: Existing task can be edited.
Saved changes are visible in the task list.

US-CAT-001.title: Task categories
US-CAT-001.description: As a user, I want to categorize tasks.

acceptance_criteria.text: Task can have University, Work, Personal or Other category.
Selected category is displayed on the task.
Tasks can be filtered by category.

US-SUB-001.title: Subtasks
US-SUB-001.description: As a user, I want to divide a task into smaller subtasks.

acceptance_criteria.text: User can add one or more subtasks.
Empty subtask rows are not saved.
A saved subtask can be completed and reopened.
Task displays completed/total subtask progress.

US-IMP-001.title: Important tasks
US-IMP-001.description: As a user, I want to mark important tasks.

acceptance_criteria.text: Task can be marked or unmarked important.
Important task displays an Important indicator.
Important filter displays only important tasks.

US-OVERDUE-001.title: Overdue status
US-OVERDUE-001.description: As a user, I want overdue tasks highlighted.

acceptance_criteria.text: Task is overdue when due date is before today and status is not Completed.
Overdue task displays an Overdue indicator.
Completed task is never overdue.
Overdue filter displays only overdue tasks.

US-PROFILE-001.title: Change name
US-PROFILE-001.description: As a logged-in user, I want to change my displayed name.

acceptance_criteria.text: Current name is shown in the form.
Name is required and must have at least 2 characters.
Saved valid name updates sidebar and greeting.
Updated name persists for the same registered account.

US-FILTER-001.title: Search/filter/sort tasks
US-FILTER-001.description: As a user, I want to find tasks quickly.

acceptance_criteria.text: Tasks can be searched by title or description.
Tasks can be filtered by priority, category, status, important or overdue.
Tasks can be sorted by newest, priority, due date or title.
